query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM notifications n
            WHERE n.account_id = $2
              AND n.id > COALESCE(
                  (SELECT last_read_id FROM markers
                   WHERE user_id = $1 AND timeline = 'notifications'),
                  0)
              AND NOT n.filtered
              AND NOT sender_filtered($2, n.from_account_id)
        ) AS "unread!"
